report_level_evaluation.participants: n: 6; female: 3; male: 3; age range: 22; 43; age median: 26; background: Different professions, none in IT; no ontology/SemanticWeb experience
report_level_evaluation.tasks: 8 DBpedia tasks:7 query-construction tasks and1 graph-comprehension task, after4.5min video and training task; German session with bilingual tasks
report_level_evaluation.measures: Screen recordings, observed interaction and final questionnaire
report_level_evaluation.results: Participants solved most tasks;5/6 readily interpreted the comprehension query. Classes/individuals, relationship direction, and shared literal nodes caused confusion.; limits: Small qualitative sample; no comparison with another interface, no aggregate task-time/accuracy effect estimate; study relates to an earlier workshop version.
report_level_evaluation.limitations: Not reported: comparator. Small qualitative sample; no comparison with another interface, no aggregate task-time/accuracy effect estimate; study relates to an earlier workshop version.
